name: offmesh-monorepo
description: OffMesh Monorepo - E2E Encrypted Opportunistic Mesh Mobile App, Modular Backend, and Documentation Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,DOCS,LANDING,MOBILE,WEB" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,blue.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold" "pnpm --filter offmesh-backend dev" "pnpm --filter offmesh-docs start" "pnpm --filter offmesh-landing dev" "node scripts/run-mobile.js" "node scripts/run-web.js"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter offmesh-backend build && pnpm --filter offmesh-docs build && pnpm --filter offmesh-landing build
